subject: mid-range Android terrain flyover with three postprocess passes
assumptions: Target frame rate is 60 FPS (16.67 ms total frame budget, ~12.5 ms GPU budget on mid-range mobile).
Three full-resolution postprocess passes likely dominate memory bandwidth and fragment fill-rate during low-altitude camera sweeps.
derivations: bandwidthBps (1080p @ DPR 2.0, 4 passes, RGBA8 read+write) = 2160 * 3840 * 8 * 4 * 60 = 15.92 GB/s; clamping DPR to 1.35 reduces pixel traffic by 54%
key_decisions: Measure low-altitude camera passes separately from high-altitude passes using EXT_disjoint_timer_query_webgl2 or single-pass toggles because overdraw and fill-rate shift sharply near ground level.
Halve resolution (0.5x per axis) on bloom/fog postprocess passes and call gl.invalidateFramebuffer on transient depth attachments before reducing terrain mesh triangle counts.
Keep KTX2 texture fetch/transcode and terrain chunk generation in Web Workers, while sorting single-context GL draws front-to-back for opaque terrain chunks.
parallel_tasks: query capability limits and EXT_disjoint_timer_query_webgl2 support while auditing the FBO pass graph
measure frame-time deltas across individual postprocess toggles while drafting the DPR clamp curve
prepare PBO + gl.fenceSync smoke and context-loss regression checks in parallel with shader branch cleanup
risks: Low-altitude flight shifts the bottleneck from vertex transform to fragment overdraw and tile-memory bandwidth.
Three full-resolution postprocess passes can saturate mobile tile memory if transient depth/stencil buffers are flushed back to RAM.
Sampling terrain detail textures inside non-uniform branches without textureGrad can cause mipmap seam artifacts along 2x2 quad boundaries.
next_steps: toggle the three postprocess passes one at a time and record frame-time deltas
clamp targetDPR to 1.35-1.5 on mid-range Android and drop bloom/AO FBOs to 0.5x resolution
call gl.invalidateFramebuffer(gl.FRAMEBUFFER, [gl.DEPTH_ATTACHMENT]) after the scene color resolve pass
sort opaque terrain chunks front-to-back and bind chunk transforms via an aligned std140 UBO
validation_gates: Verify gl.checkFramebufferStatus(gl.FRAMEBUFFER) === gl.FRAMEBUFFER_COMPLETE on all half-res postprocess FBOs
Confirm GPU_DISJOINT_EXT is false before accepting EXT_disjoint_timer_query_webgl2 pass timings
